proposals.problem: Tasks can carry an explicit assignment to an offline or incapable worker, or none at all; the dashboard can only report this.
proposals.baseline: explicit assignment only (what HIVE Core records report)
proposals.candidate: advisory capability + freshness match: keep a good explicit assignment, otherwise suggest the first live worker whose declared capabilities cover the task
proposals.hypothesis: An advisory capability/freshness match raises the share of good assignments and removes assignments to offline/incapable workers.
proposals.expected_benefit: Fewer stalled tasks; clearer routing advice for HIVE Core (advice only, never applied by the dashboard).

success_metrics.target: accept a trade-off only with review

test_plan: advice never changes a task record
no relationship is shown without an explicit worker field

rollback.plan: Revert the commit that adds the advice; observations return to report-only.

required_permissions: reviewed code change (pull request); no new runtime permission
proposals.problem: A single failed preflight marks a connector OFFLINE immediately; transient blips appear as outages.
proposals.candidate: two consecutive failures => OFFLINE, probe every second tick while OFFLINE
proposals.hypothesis: Requiring two failures removes transient false OFFLINE states and reduces probe calls, at the cost of slower detection.
proposals.expected_benefit: Fewer false OFFLINE flaps and fewer probe calls during outages.
test_plan: an unreachable Core is still reported, never hidden

rollback.plan: Revert the policy change; single-failure preflight returns.

proposals.problem: The 120 s ULTRON freshness window keeps ULTRON ACTIVE for up to two minutes after its last event.
proposals.candidate: ULTRON ACTIVE window 60 s (180 s also measured for comparison)
proposals.hypothesis: A shorter window reduces false ACTIVE time; it may increase false STALE time when events are sparse.
proposals.expected_benefit: ULTRON ACTIVE is closer to real activity; silence turns STALE sooner.
test_plan: ring and registry use the same window

rollback.plan: Revert the window constant to 120 s.
